changes: GetPattern and GetCursor use the ordinary resource search. The later ROM-first requests are absent. The common wrappers for patterns, cursors, strings, icons, and pictures otherwise retain their released bodies.

GetNewWindow restores its zero-byte stack frame and direct GetResource call. It pushes the original template fields, locks the template with master-pointer bit seven, calls NewWindow, and releases the resource. Color windows, automatic positioning, palettes, color tables, and delayed visibility are omitted.
GetNewControl similarly restores its zero-byte stack frame, combined template-field pushes, direct master-pointer lock, and ReleaseResource call. Color tables and delayed visibility are absent.

GetMenu retains the April 1985 resource-state and initialization checks, the July 1985 ROM-map insertion before loading MDEF, and CalcMenuSize. The later ROM-map insertion before GetResInfo and the menu color-table path are absent.
GetNewMBar calls the local GetMenu routine with BSR.W and releases the menu-bar template after loading it. The original menu-bar save, replacement, and restoration sequence remains.

Original attribution, 1983–1985 histories, routine contracts, and inline comments remain where they describe the earlier code. The header omits GetNewCWindow and the control-template comment uses the correct CNTL resource type. Three short-branch forms retain the ROM encodings.
historical_limits: The source comparison and exact assembly verify emitted instructions and data. They do not exercise resource loading with applications or recover the lost source text.
